'''Bairdon Jace''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] in the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He wielded a blue-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].

==Biography==
[[File:BairdonJacweKhaatQiyn-SWCTP.png|thumb|left|200px|Jace with his Jedi Master, Khaat Qiyn]]
Jace was apprenticed to [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Khaat Qiyn/Legends|Khaat Qiyn]].<ref name="AOTCVD">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref><ref name="SWCTP">''[[Star Wars Chronicles: The Prequels]]''</ref>

The Master-Padawan duo was at the [[Grand Convocation Chamber]] on the evening of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate's]] decision to create the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. Both were part of [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu's]] [[Jedi assault team/Legends|task force]] sent to [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] to rescue [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] from the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Separatist Council/Legends|leaders]] just prior to the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Jace fought in the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]] alongside his Master and survived.<ref name="The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref><ref name="ITWOAOTC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The entry for Bairdon Jace in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' calls him a Jedi Knight. This discrepancy has not been addressed.
